title: pref/recents payload
description: UPSERT payload of pref/recents: the account's recent searches, the same on every device it signs in on. Last writer wins, and the list is one value: two devices' lists are never merged. Clearing the list is a DELETE with an empty payload, never an empty list. Serialized, at most 12,166 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

searches.description: 1 to 10 distinct searches, the newest first.

items.description: What the user searched for, as typed and trimmed: 1 to 200 Unicode code points. Private to the user: never logged.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
